title: every doctor line is `<status> <check>: <detail>` with the status padded to four characters, then one summary line
source: intended: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-22 and the doctor spec (defect N-20): a read-only health check
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20, B4.5). doctor prints one line per check, `ok  `, `warn` or `fail` padded to four characters, a space, the check id, a colon and a one-line detail, and then `doctor: <n> ok, <n> warn, <n> fail` as the last line. On a default project nothing fails, so the exit code is 0.
